sloka: अंहो बतेदम् नृ वर अविषह्य निवर्तते मे हृदि साधु वृत्तम् ।अग्नौ विवर्णम् परितप्य मानम् किट्टम् यथा राघव जात रूपम् ॥४-२४-१८॥
transliteration: aṁho batedam nṛ vara aviṣahya nivartate me hṛdi sādhu vṛttam ।agnau vivarṇam paritapya mānam kiṭṭam yathā rāghava jāta rūpam ॥4-24-18॥

translations.english: 'O distinguished Rama this anxiety is unbearable for me. My good behaviour is relegated to the back of my heart unable to bear the sin, just like the dirt surfaces pushing the bright colour of gold when burnt in fire.
